Definition: Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eljasaph is the name of two Israelites. In Numbers 1:14, the text says "Eliasaph the son of Deuel."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eljasaph matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
